steps.content: Until the tide falls at dawn

The lighthouse platform has become the final stronghold, besieged by the crushing weight of the waves and the relentless tide of monsters. Rainwater, mingled with the putrid fluids of corrupted flesh, floods every crack and groove. The entire structure groans, trembling under the constant, brutal impacts.
Ceto swipes a hand across her eyes, clearing the blood that clouds her vision, and turns to the frail figure behind her.

${PlayerName}'s strength is clearly spent. The navigation beacon sputters, its light growing erratic. Cracks spiderweb across the housing. With insufficient power, the capacitors fail to hold a charge, and the beam is swallowed by the thick sea fog, unable to pierce the darkness.
Yet, you still try to force a smile.
Don't worry... I still got a B+ on the MBCC fitness test... once...

But the brave facade shatters as the platform lurches violently. Your legs buckle, dropping you to your knees. The shackles binding you both snap under the strain. The battery pack's indicator flickers, hovering just above zero.
In the dying light, Ceto's gaze falls on your hands—a raw, bloody mess of torn blisters.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: This won't do. The light's too weak to reach them. And the fleet isn't coming to rescue a dying person.
There has to be a way... Think! There has to be something useful that Fynn taught me!

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Rule Number One: Signal and Surveillance! Monitor the border without fail. Ensure signal transmission. Report all enemy movement. We are the frontline guardians. We fear nothing, and are ready to sacrifice all for the city-state!

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Rule Number Two: Beacon Maintenance! The light is our most reliable signal. Keeping the lighthouses operational is our primary duty!

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: There has to be a way—
[Flashback] [Training Grounds]

steps.speaker: Fynn
steps.content: Alright, listen up! Today, we'll be learning Lighthouse Keeper's Code, Rule Three: Emergency Procedures.

steps.speaker: Fynn
steps.content: If lighthouse equipment is damaged and unable to transmit signals, immediately use semaphore to contact other outposts or Command. Semaphore is a reliable form of communication, ensuring that even if the lighthouse is inoperative, we can still relay critical information...
On the training grounds swept by a sandstorm, twelve-year-old Ceto held up a flag, nearly toppled by the raging winds.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: If I learn all this... I can join you, right? Then... I can go to DisCity with you?
Fynn's scabbard gently tapped the top of her head.

steps.speaker: Fynn
steps.content: It's not that simple, Ceto. Remember, semaphore isn't just a signal. It's the anchor that holds the keepers fast in the storm! It tells your enemies and your comrades one thing...
Fynn's withered hand suddenly surged with strength as she grabbed Ceto and thrust the flag in her hands directly into the howling wind!

steps.speaker: Fynn
steps.content: We are still standing!
[Flashback]

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Your hand! Now!
What for?
Before you can finish your question, she's already tearing strips from her tattered uniform jacket. She wraps the bright fabric around a broken metal rod, fashioning a crude distress flag.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: The west window's still clear. Get over there and do exactly as I say.
Rapidly, she traces symbols into your palm. You recognize them—universal signals for help. She thrusts the bloodstained banner into your arms and shoves you toward the only intact window.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Memorize this signal. Repeat it, face the sea, and don't look back. You are going to execute Rule Three of the Lighthouse Keeper's Code.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: From now on, you are the beacon.
With no time to think, you're pushed to the western window. You raise the flag as she taught you. The first sequence begins—

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Wider!

Behind you, the whistle of her blade cutting the air is followed by the wet shatter of monstrosities. Something heavy slams against the tower walls. Without the shackles connecting you, there's no way to know how she's holding up.
Second sequence...

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Can you see... the fleet...
Not as clear as before, but I can barely make out the red warning lights on the bows of the fleet. They're approaching faster than expected!

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: That's enough for them to see us now.
Third sequence begins. Warm liquid splatters against the back of your neck.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: You're losing the rhythm!
Her shout is sharp, punctuated by a suppressed groan of pain.
Fourth sequence. Your movements grow steadier, but the pace of her blade has slowed, now half a beat behind.
Tenth sequence. Her breathing has fractured into ragged gasps. The sound of steel meeting flesh grows dull, infrequent.
You almost turn; the urge to look is a physical pull. But her voice cuts through the chaos, raw and strained:

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Don't stop... Don't look back...
You continue sending the signals mechanically, knuckles white with tension, never stopping waving the flag.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Soon... we'll see the sun...

Another crash echoes, this time with the shriek of twisting metal. The coppery tang of blood thickens in the air. A warm, thick liquid seeps around your boots. You're certain it's not from the creatures...
Fifteenth sequence...
Behind you, there is only silence now.
Ceto, how are you holding up?
No response...
Ceto?
[Injured Ceto CG] [Stirring, Heroic, Tragic Bgm]

She is still fighting. A length of steel rebar, thrust through the broken railing, has impaled her through the ribs, pinning her body in place. She uses it as a grisly prop, a final brace to keep herself upright and refusing to fall.
Even now—with the whites of her eyes flooded crimson—her gaze remains locked on the horde.

steps.speaker: Echoes in Mind
steps.content: Stand facing it, fight for it, and never, ever let the lighthouse beacon go out.

steps.speaker: Echoes in Mind
steps.content: We'll all go back together... return to DisCity in glory!

steps.speaker: Echoes in Mind
steps.content: From now on, you are the beacon.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: No... the beacon can't go out...
Her lips are cracked and bleeding. Her mouth moves with agonizing slowness, shaping words that can barely find voice.
[CG: Close-up of Injured Ceto]

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Go back... home...
Darkness rises like a tide, and Ceto feels herself sinking. The pain has faded, replaced by a deep, encroaching cold. A distant light glimmers, always just out of reach.
The first sounds that reach her ears are footsteps—boots striking metal, steady and clear, echoing from somewhere beyond the chaos.
[Portraits of Fallen Keepers]

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: You all... How come?
